fact: The Secretary of State for the Digital Economy said a national strategy of skills and digital readiness, part of the World Bank-funded Digital Cabo Verde project, is being prepared after a workshop in Praia.
system: National strategy of skills and digital readiness

fact: The Cabo Verde government launched the Skodji Digital programme to train up to 3,000 young people in digital skills, with 1,050 participants in the first phase and applications open to 25 February.
Resolução 72/2026 recognises as progress digital-inclusion and skills-training initiatives developed for citizens and public servants.

The document says the World Bank-financed Digital Cabo Verde Project supports WebLab Phase II to train youth and women in digital skills (coding, robotics), aiming to certify 25,000 youth with 50% female participation.
